column1: # What this game needs of an Android phone, for the launcher's readiness check (android/README.md "Readiness check"; the format in dm/games/README.md "Readiness rows").
# A status row also marks the game as supported on Android: gradle.properties' nxGames builds every such profile into the APK (dm/tools/tests/test_android_games.py).
# In bring-up on Android: plays on the phone; the picture is over-bright and mesh draws are missing on Turnip (the note, Open)
# The library contains 500 mesh and 20 task programs. There is no compute fallback
# on the Vulkan replay: without these features it drops foliage and other models.
# Check reported capabilities, not the driver name (including Qualcomm drivers).

column4: Mesh shaders: foliage and other models need VK_EXT_mesh_shader; this build has no fallback and would leave their geometry out
Mesh shaders: the driver must enable the mesh stage to draw the game's mesh programs
Task shaders: the game's task programs generate mesh workgroups and cannot run without taskShader
